prompt_text: The first attached contact sheet contains cropped source references with scene backgrounds; extract only the named physical subject from each crop and discard every room/background, text, lighting, gesture marks, and unrelated person/object. Items in reading order map to atlas rows: row 1: Chest Scene Patch (concept-new--chest-scene-patch); row 2: Wardrobe Sign Scene Patch (concept-new--wardrobe-sign-scene-patch); row 3: Unicorn Mannequin Scene Patch (concept-new--unicorn-mannequin-scene-patch); row 4: Disco Ball Scene Patch (concept-new--disco-ball-scene-patch); row 5: Inspect Cabinet Scene Patch (concept-new--inspect-cabinet-scene-patch); row 6: House Door Scene Patch (concept-new--house-door-scene-patch). Preserve the subject's visible identity, silhouette, proportions, material and palette. The second transparent center-dot guide indicates exactly 6 equal columns by 6 rows; do not reproduce dots. Columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Strict axis-aligned orthographic, not perspective or three-quarter. Front/rear are true opposite broad elevations; right/left true side elevations. TOP looks straight down along Z; BOTTOM straight up along Z; for standing actors pose is identical and body occludes the view, show shoes/hands undersides as appropriate without changing pose or presenting the whole face/torso. Upright architecture top/bottom show footprint/underside, with height occluded. Props show overhead footprint and undersurface, not frontal face. Do not mirror/fake opposite 3D sides. Unseen surfaces are inferred and should be conservative, not claimed recovered from the scene image. One complete isolated subject per cell, centered, no clipping/duplicates/cell leakage. Transparent background. No labels, text, borders, gridlines, scene backdrop, shadows or new nearby objects. Source isolation notes: Chest Scene Patch: not a clean sprite.
